title: Clearly distinguish I/O graph and plot graph value_strings
description: Both I/O graph and plot dialog had separately named graph_style_vs value_strings with different values within them.  This led to bug where the incorrect graph_style_vs was being used in wireshark_main_window_slots.  Correct 7b2fe54916f4410719c410cb7bbef24fd71b52d2 by making each graph_style_vs uniquely named an move the I/O graph version to the header file so it can be used by wireshark_main_window_slots.

commits_data.message:
Clearly distinguish I/O graph and plot graph value_strings

Both I/O graph and plot dialog had separately named graph_style_vs value_strings with different values within them.  This led to bug where the incorrect graph_style_vs was being used in wireshark_main_window_slots.  Correct 7b2fe54916f4410719c410cb7bbef24fd71b52d2 by making each graph_style_vs uniquely named an move the I/O graph version to the header file so it can be used by wireshark_main_window_slots.
